verdict.rationale: monday.com documents a public GraphQL Platform API for interacting with workflows, automating processes and powering integrations, alongside SDKs, granular scopes like `boards:read`, and event subscriptions. Probes confirm machine-readable API documentation is live: an llms.txt describing the Platform API and an OpenAPI spec at a well-known path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving the product through the API, and evidence of API coverage depth or rate limits.
